name: Claude Project Context Manager
description: A skill and agent plugin that reads your project's architecture documentation — README.md, architecture.md, and related files — and enforces those documented conventions on every code change Claude makes. Includes a /project-context skill for on-demand rule extraction, an architecture-reviewer subagent that performs deep read-only compliance analysis with structured PASS/WARN/FAIL reports, and a SessionStart hook that automatically loads project context when Claude launches. longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **1 agent** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (1): `project-context` (Scans README.md and architecture.md to extract project conventions, tech stack, directory structure rules, and architectural constraints)
- **Agents** (1): `architecture-reviewer` (Expert architecture reviewer that deeply analyzes code changes against project documentation)
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-project-context-manager@claude-community` from `its-animay/claude-project-context-manager`.
